name: TDM Rewards x2
description: Every Kill Coin and SP reward from Tokyo Death Metro is multiplied by 2.
author: KSFA

patches.sql: UPDATE master_tdm_rank SET win_bns_spirit = win_bns_spirit * 2, win_bns_money = win_bns_money * 2, def_bns_spirit = def_bns_spirit * 2, def_bns_money = def_bns_money * 2, def_bns_spirit_limit = def_bns_spirit_limit * 2, def_bns_money_limit = def_bns_money_limit * 2, weekly_bns_spirit = weekly_bns_spirit * 2, weekly_bns_money = weekly_bns_money * 2;
UPDATE master_war_reward SET win_spirit = win_spirit * 2, win_money = win_money * 2, lose_spirit = lose_spirit * 2, lose_money = lose_money * 2;
